heading: Friday, April 25, 2025
topLine: Moonshot AI open-sources Kimi-Audio foundation model.

items.headline: Moonshot AI open-sources Kimi-Audio foundation model
items.summary: Kimi-Audio-7B is an open-source audio foundation model for speech recognition, audio understanding, audio generation and voice conversation, pretrained on more than 13 million hours of audio. Moonshot reports state-of-the-art results on several audio benchmarks; the Instruct weights, inference code and technical report were released first, with base weights following.
